sub_graphs.title: EIP-2464: Transaction Announcement Protocol
sub_graphs.description: Models the transaction announcement flow using NewPooledTransactionHashes message in eth/65 protocol

nodes.label: Transaction in Local Mempool
nodes.description: A transaction exists in the local node's transaction pool and is eligible for announcement

nodes.label: Select Peers for Announcement
nodes.description: Node selects peers that are unlikely to already know about the transaction

nodes.label: Build Hash Announcement Message
nodes.description: Construct NewPooledTransactionHashes message with up to 4096 transaction hashes (128KB limit)

nodes.label: Transaction Hashes Announced
nodes.description: NewPooledTransactionHashes (0x08) message has been sent to selected peers

nodes.label: Peer Received Hash Announcement
nodes.description: Remote peer has received NewPooledTransactionHashes and can decide to request full transactions

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2464: Transaction Retrieval Protocol
sub_graphs.description: Models the request-response flow for retrieving full transactions via GetPooledTransactions/PooledTransactions

nodes.label: Transaction Hashes Received
nodes.description: Node has received NewPooledTransactionHashes and identified unknown transactions

nodes.label: Build Transaction Request
nodes.description: Construct GetPooledTransactions request with up to 256 transaction hashes

nodes.label: Lookup Transactions in Pool
nodes.description: Responding node looks up requested transactions in its mempool only (not disk)

nodes.label: Build Transaction Response
nodes.description: Construct PooledTransactions response in same order as request, skipping unavailable

nodes.label: PooledTransactions Sent
nodes.description: PooledTransactions (0x0a) response sent back to requester

nodes.label: Full Transactions Received
nodes.description: Requester has received full transaction data

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2464: Message Validation and Constraints
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation rules and constraints for eth/65 transaction messages

nodes.label: Protocol Message Received
nodes.description: A NewPooledTransactionHashes, GetPooledTransactions, or PooledTransactions message received

nodes.label: Check devp2p Packet Size Limit
nodes.description: Verify message does not exceed 10MB devp2p network packet limit

nodes.label: Check Hash Count Limit
nodes.description: For announcements: verify max 4096 hashes (128KB). For requests: verify max 256 hashes

nodes.label: Message Valid
nodes.description: Message passed all validation checks and can be processed

nodes.label: Message Invalid
nodes.description: Message failed validation - may indicate protocol violation or resource limits

nodes.label: Process Valid Message
nodes.description: Process the validated message according to its type

external_entities.name: Remote Peer Node
external_entities.description: Another Ethereum node communicating via eth/65 protocol

ambiguities.text: Nodes should only announce hashes to peers 'unlikely to know' about them
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementation-specific heuristics such as tracking recently sent hashes per peer or using bloom filters. The exact algorithm is left to implementations.

ambiguities.text: Responses indicating 'size limits or serving time limits' aren't protocol violations
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume that partial responses or empty responses due to resource constraints are acceptable and should not trigger peer disconnection.

ambiguities.text: No specification for handling duplicate hash announcements from the same peer
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume nodes should track recently received announcements and deduplicate requests to avoid redundant fetches.

implicit_assumptions.description: Peers respond honestly to GetPooledTransactions requests with actual transactions matching the hashes
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious peers could return wrong transactions for requested hashes, potentially causing state inconsistencies or enabling transaction injection attacks

implicit_assumptions.description: All connected peers support eth/65 protocol version
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Protocol version mismatch could cause message parsing failures or dropped connections with legacy nodes

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot flood the network with fake transaction hash announcements at scale
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Bandwidth amplification attacks possible where small hash announcements trigger large transaction requests
